note: Well-known Indian trade names of pesticides that are banned, restricted, frequently misused or widely sold, mapped to their active ingredient. A listing that names only the trade name is matched to the chemical with match type 'brand' (medium confidence): the trade name identifies the product, but only the label proves what is inside. Kept deliberately short; every entry is a long-established, widely documented trade name. Only distinctive names are listed (not ordinary words), since a trade name alone puts a listing in scope. Hitweed maps to Pyrithiobac Sodium, the ingredient common to Godrej's Hitweed products.
